chapter.verse: Vantung-a a ompa aw, nangmah kong ento hi!
En in, nasem pasalte in a topa uh muang a, nasem numei in a tonu-uh a muan’ mah bangin, ko tungah hehpihna nong neih matengin Topa kote’ Pasian kong mitsuan uh hi.
Kote hong hehpih in, Topa aw, kote hong hehpih in, bang hang hiam cih leh kote in ka thuak zawh loh uh simmawhna ka thuak uh hi.
A ut ut-a gamta mite’ hong zahkona, mi kiphasakte’ hong simmawhna tawh sau vei ka gim lua khin ta uh hi.
